sloka: अनिष्टे सुभगाकारे सौभग्येन विकत्थसे ।चलं हि तव सौभाग्यं नद्याः स्रोत इवोष्णगे ॥२-७-१५॥
transliteration: aniṣṭe subhagākāre saubhagyena vikatthase ।calaṁ hi tava saubhāgyaṁ nadyāḥ srota ivoṣṇage ॥2-7-15॥

translations.english: Though you appear to be your husband's darling, in reality he dislikes you. The good fortune you boast of indeed is unstable like the stream of a river in summer.
